lines: Yaar, teri hurrr aur teri bhodam ke bina meri life ekdum boring hoti.
SBI aur IBPS ka tension mat le. Tu officer ban hi jayegi, aur main tujhe salute marunga (thoda sa, dikhane ke liye 😅).
Aaj bas khush reh, thoda kam gussa kar, aur extra cake kha. Padhai kal bhi ho jayegi.
Main aa nahi paya, isliye flipbook mein aaya. Kele ka chhilka, kutta, baarish… sab jhela tere liye. Nasharam, thodi to kadar kar le! 😜
Hamesha aise hi hasti reh. Tera dost hamesha tere saath hai.
